title: 第13章 李莲花第14章 单孤刀他死了
content_zh:
李相夷只是失忆了，并不是傻了，他发现自己身边一个四顾门的旧友都没有，一直照顾自己的都是金鸳盟的人和方多病，他就明白了，这症结恐怕不在笛飞声身上。
但要想了解事情的真相恐怕也要从笛飞声身上下手，想和笛飞声心平气和的交谈必须先要控制住自己的脾气。
李相夷认为自己不是一个好脾气的人，自己从不宽宥任何一个人！
还没等李相夷再多想什么，门“吱呀”一声，被人从外面推开，方多病捧着药碗又进来了。
“云彼丘死了吗？”李相夷一边接过方多病递过来的药碗一边问道，按照自己的性格，但凡能动，第一件事就是要回去杀了云彼丘。
方多病摇了摇头，“没有。”
怎么这少年的语气里还有一丝遗憾，好像也盼着云彼丘早日投胎。
“我没杀他？”李相夷有些不可置信，这十年自己都在干什么？身体也没养好，仇也没报，如今事事都要靠眼前的少年，十年后的自己竟窝囊至此？！
“没有，你原谅了他！”
于是，方多病将李相夷如何从东海得以生还，如何靠种萝卜养活自己，又为何改名李莲花的经过原原本本的告诉了他。
“就这样，你原谅了所有人，甚至用自己最后一点儿内力救了中了雪中蝉的云彼丘。”
“我原谅了所有人？”李相夷有些不可置信，自己竟豁达至此！
碗中的药已经凉了，李相夷也不等方多病再去热，直接一口饮下，将药碗递还给少年，接过少年手中剥好了糖纸的桂花糖。
他心中也不知是畅快还是难过，这些往事自己还要好好消化一番。
眼下最重要的还是要养好身体，至于四顾门的旧人，他们不来亦不用见，各自安好也就是了。
至此，李相夷每天好好吃饭，好好睡觉，好好吃药，逐渐也有了些李莲花的形容。
要说李相夷还有什么不满的地方，就是这药实在是太苦了，也还好，那少年手中好像有吃不完的桂花糖。
第四天，李相夷才又再见到笛飞声。
笛飞声是拿着少师的断剑进的屋，看见李相夷坐在床上，直接就将少师的残骸抛入李相夷怀中。
“是你？你断了我的剑？”李相夷用手摸着少师的剑柄，心中不舍，少师也好像多年的老友似的，在他手中诉说自己的委屈。

“自然不是，是剑的主人舍弃了它！”笛飞声俯看着李相夷。
“我？我怎么会？”
“十年前的李相夷自然不会，十年后的嘛……”真相就在眼前。
和在小青峰时的那晚一样，笛飞声将他们查到的结果告诉了李相夷，洗脱了三王的冤屈，但更多的事儿，笛飞声就不肯多说了，只说自己不受不白之冤，之后的事由方多病拿捏着尺寸，以后再慢慢告诉李相夷。
content_en:
Li Xiangyi just lost his memory, not stupid. He found that he didn't have any old friends around him, and the people who had been taking care of him were the people of the Golden Yuan Alliance and Fang Duobing. He understood that the crux of the problem was probably not Di Feisheng.
But if you want to know the truth of the matter, you probably have to start with Di Feisheng. If you want to have a calm conversation with Di Feisheng, you must first control your temper.
Li Xiangyi thinks that he is not a good-tempered person and he never forgives anyone!
Before Li Xiangyi could think any more, the door creaked and someone pushed it open from the outside. Fang Duobing came in again holding a medicine bowl.
"Is Yun Biqiu dead?" Li Xiangyi asked while taking the medicine bowl handed over by Fang Duobing. According to his personality, if he could move, the first thing he would do was to go back and kill Yun Biqiu.
Fang Duobing shook his head, "No."
Why is there a hint of regret in this young man's tone, as if he is also looking forward to Yun Biqiu's early reincarnation.
"I didn't kill him?" Li Xiangyi couldn't believe it. What had he been doing in the past ten years? I haven't taken good care of my health, and I haven't avenged my revenge. Now I have to rely on the young man in front of me for everything. Ten years later, I will be so useless? !
"No, you forgive him!"
Therefore, Fang Duobing told him exactly how Li Xiangyi survived from the East China Sea, how he supported himself by growing radishes, and why he changed his name to Li Lianhua.
"In this way, you forgave everyone, and even used your last bit of inner strength to save Yun Biqiu from the cicada in the snow."
"Have I forgiven everyone?" Li Xiangyi was a little unbelievable that he was so open-minded!
The medicine in the bowl was already cold, so Li Xiangyi drank it directly without waiting for Fang Duoyi to cool down. He handed the medicine bowl back to the young man and took the osmanthus candy with its wrapper peeled off from the young man's hand.
He didn't know whether he felt happy or sad. He still had to digest these past events.
The most important thing right now is to take good care of your health. As for the old people who are looking around, you don't need to see them if they don't come. Just stay well.
At this point, Li Xiangyi eats well, sleeps well, and takes medicine well every day, and gradually begins to resemble Li Lianhua.
If there was anything Li Xiangyi was dissatisfied with, it was that the medicine was too bitter. Fortunately, the young man seemed to have endless osmanthus candies in his hands.
On the fourth day, Li Xiangyi saw Di Feisheng again.
Di Feisheng entered the room with the broken sword of the young master. When he saw Li Xiangyi sitting on the bed, he immediately threw the remains of the young master into Li Xiangyi's arms.
"Is it you? Did you break my sword?" Li Xiangyi touched the hilt of the young master's sword with his hand, feeling reluctant to let go. The young master also expressed his grievances in his hand like an old friend for many years.
"Of course not, the owner of the sword abandoned it!" Di Fei said looking down at Li Xiangyi.
"Me? How could I?"
"Li Xiangyi ten years ago certainly wouldn't, but ten years later..." The truth is right in front of you.
Just like the night at Xiao Qingfeng, Di Feisheng told Li Xiangyi the results of their investigation and cleared the three kings of their grievances. However, Di Feisheng refused to say more about more things. He only said that he was not unfairly wronged. Fang Duobing was careful about what happened next and would tell Li Xiangyi slowly in the future.
